title: Jelly-like Silky Ukrainian Phyllo dough Vareniki
description: A delicate Ukrainian dish featuring phyllo dough, filled with a sweet and tangy filling, boiled to perfection. Often served as a brunch option.

ingredients.name: Strained ricotta cheese
ingredients.notes: Squeeze out as much liquid as possible before using.

instructions: Preheat a large pot of water and bring to a boil.
Combine ricotta cheese, granulated sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla extract in a bowl and mix until smooth.
Brush a sheet of phyllo dough with melted butter and place on a work surface.
Place a tablespoon of the ricotta mixture in the center of the phyllo dough.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling, until all ingredients are used.
Carefully place the vareniki into the boiling water and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the vareniki from the water with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess water.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh dill and dust with powdered sugar.
